result.summary: The image shows a signalized urban intersection in a mixed-use residential area with marked zebra crosswalks and sidewalks. While basic infrastructure is present, the wide crossing distance and parked vehicles near corners create potential visibility and exposure risks for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Daylighting / Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles close to the intersection corners may block the view between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right sides of the side street intersection.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross a wide roadway without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crossing across the main road.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to ensure clear sight lines for all road users.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential street with row housing and a marked zebra crosswalk. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and markings are present, the crossing lacks active controls, signage, or physical traffic calming to protect pedestrians from through traffic.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Cars parked close to the crosswalk on both sides of the street may block sightlines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs adjacent to the zebra crosswalk

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: The marked crosswalk lacks any accompanying stop signs, traffic signals, or warning signage to alert drivers to yield.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install high-visibility warning signs (W11-2) to alert motorists of the pedestrian crossing.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked zebra crosswalks and curb ramps within a mixed-use residential and commercial setting. However, the environment lacks dedicated pedestrian signals at the signalized crossing, and sightlines are partially obstructed by parked vehicles near the intersection.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The intersection is controlled by vehicle traffic lights but lacks dedicated pedestrian signal heads, creating ambiguity for crossing pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: At the intersection corners where traffic lights are mounted.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles, including a truck, are located close to the crosswalk, which can hide pedestrians from oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway near the marked crosswalk.

hazards.name: Pavement and Marking Wear
hazards.description: The roadway surface is cracked and the crosswalk markings are beginning to fade, reducing visibility and creating potential trip hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the foreground roadway and crosswalk area.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Installation
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and increase the visibility of pedestrians waiting to cross.
